topic: Why Venus is the hottest planet
script: Venus is the hottest planet, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun. Its surface is about 465 degrees Celsius, hot enough to melt lead. Its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat like a blanket. The air pressure there is about 90 times greater than on Earth. That is like being nearly a kilometer deep in the ocean.
